title: Jev routing note in Claude Code (opt-in)
description: Adds Jev's advisory routing note to each Claude Code prompt. Off by default: on the Opus/Haiku benchmark (bench/jev-opus) it changed no outcomes and added ~3% tokens and ~1 s per prompt. Codex and opencode get the note from the jev component.
postInstall: Jev routing note enabled for Claude Code (UserPromptSubmit hook). Start a new Claude Code session to load it. Opt out per project with .claude/jev-off, everywhere with JEV_HOOK=0 (that also turns off the gate).
